Secluded Courtyard/chosen-type-mana-cast: {T}: Add one mana of any color, spend this mana only to cast a creature spell of the chosen type -- after activating for {R} with Goblin chosen, the cast option for Raging Goblin#2 is not offered at all (only pass/concede): type-restricted 'any color' mana cannot pay for a legal cast of the chosen type (CR 605.3a). The scenario's positive control (the same cast paid with unrestricted mana) passes, isolating the restriction.
Vanquisher's Banner/other-type-creatures: The chosen type is ignored: with Human chosen the +1/+1 lands on the NON-Human Grizzly Bears (3/3) while the Human Selfless Spirit stays 2/1 -- the continuous effect's type filter matches as if 'Bear' had been chosen for any choice (CR 604.3, 614.10). The sibling scenario with Bear chosen is the positive control and passes.
Banner of Kinship/no-creature-of-type-no: CR 205.3m/614.12: 'choose a creature type' allows any creature type; with Bear chosen and only a Cat (Savannah Lions) on its controller's side, the Banner enters with no fellowship counters and pumps nothing. Observed: no choice is posed at all -- the engine's type chooser offers only types among its controller's creatures, so with one candidate it auto-picks Cat (1 counter, Lions 3/2). The sibling minority-type-can-be-chosen passes (Bear picked from Bear+Cat), so the choice works when the type is present. Confidence fairly high. Related to the Vanquisher's Banner/other-type-creatures-not-pumped chooser note (types the game already knows); new for an absent type, found by the FDN audit batch 6.
Banner of Kinship/chosen-type-only-oppon: Same root as no-creature-of-type-no-counters: with Bears only on the opponent's side Bear is still not offered (the chooser lists only types among its controller's creatures), Cat is auto-picked, and the Banner gets 1 counter and pumps the Lions to 3/2. Expected 0 counters, Lions 2/1.
Banner of Kinship/active-player-gets-pri: CR 117.3b: after a spell resolves the active player receives priority. Observed: when the 'as this enters, choose a creature type' choice is posed (Bear picked from Bear and Cat), the next priority decision belongs to the NON-active player, so the active player cannot cast Grizzly Bears until the opponent passes (harness: 'p0 does not hold priority'). Controls: Vivien Reid's mid-resolution +1 choice leaves priority with its controller, and a Banner whose type is auto-picked (only Bears) does too. Confidence high. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 6; no ticket yet.
